meta_description: T.R Harris is a professional painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, local and reliable. Call 07708 085584 today.
hero_subhead: Interior and exterior painting that transforms your home. Free quotes, no obligation, same-week appointments available.
services_heading: Professional Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From interior redecoration to full exterior repaints, we handle residential and commercial projects with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Decoration
services.desc: Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and bathrooms painted to your exact specification. We protect your furnishings and leave zero mess behind.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints and colour changes for homes and commercial properties. All surfaces prepared and sealed properly for lasting protection.

services.title: Feature Walls & Accent Painting
services.desc: Create visual interest with bold feature walls, panelling effects, and custom colour schemes that bring your vision to life.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation and expert removal of old coverings without damage to plaster. Pattern matching included.

services.title: Commercial Redecorating
services.desc: Office spaces, retail units, and commercial buildings repainted to maintain your professional image. We work around your business hours.

services.title: Prep & Restoration Work
services.desc: Full surface preparation including sanding, filling, and priming ensures a flawless finish that lasts years longer.

about_pullquote: I paint homes the way I'd want my own decorated—carefully, fairly, and without hidden charges.
about_para_1: T.R Harris Painter & Decorator has been transforming Newcastle homes and businesses for over 15 years. We started because we saw too many rushed jobs and overpriced quotes in the area. Every project, whether a single bedroom or a complete commercial repaint, receives the same attention to detail and professional finish.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we turn up on time, do the job properly, and charge fairly. We've built our reputation one satisfied customer at a time—many of whom call us back for their next project. We're local, we're reliable, and we genuinely care about the quality of our work.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: T.R Harris painted our entire downstairs—lounge, kitchen, hallway. Done in three days, looked brilliant, no fuss at all. Gave us a fixed quote and stuck to it. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We weren't sure about the colour choice but T.R talked us through it. Did the exterior of our Victorian terrace—prep work was thorough and the finish is immaculate. Best tradesman we've used.
reviews.author: Catherine B.

reviews.text: Came round for a quote same week, priced fairly, did the job when he said he would. Wallpaper in two rooms and new paint throughout. Professional, tidy, honest. Very hard to find these days.
reviews.author: David P.
